the nudge counter for a campaign and return the new value.\n\n        Also records a nudge event in the campaign narration log when the actor,\n        target, and message are provided.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            if actor is not None and target is not None and message is not None:\n                row = conn.execute(\n                    \"SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?\",\n                    (campaign_id,),\n                ).fetchone()\n                sequence = (row[0] if row and row[0] is not None else 0) + (campaign_id,),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n as conn:\n            try:\n                campaign = self.get_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n                if campaign is None or campaign[\"status\"] != \"lobby\":\n                    return False\n                current_count = conn.execute(\n                    \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ?\",\n                    (campaign_id,),\n                ).fetchone()[0]\n                if current_count >= campaign[\"max_players\"]:\n                    return False\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO         conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def start_play_campaign(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Activate as conn:\n            try:\n                campaign = self.get_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n                if campaign is None or campaign[\"status\"] != \"lobby\":\n                    return False\n                current_count = conn.execute(\n                    \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ?\",\n                    (campaign_id,),\n                ).fetchone()[0]\n                if current_count >= campaign[\"max_players\"]:\n                    return False\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_members (campaign_id, username, character_id, name, class) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, username, character_id, name, class_),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def start_play_campaign(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Activate     If ``next_actor`` is provided, the campaign's current_actor is also\n        advanced to that value in the same transaction, marking the hand-off to\n        the DM for resolution.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchone()\n            sequence = (row[0] if row and row[0] is not None else 0) + 1\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, Returns the event record with the\n        ``next_actor`` and ``turn_number`` fields.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            campaign_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT owner, turn_number FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchone()\n            member_rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY rowid\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n            queue = []\n            for row in member_rows:\n                queue.append(row[0])\n                queue.append(\"dm\")\n            turn_number = campaign_row[1]\n            new_turn_number = turn_number + 1\n            next_index = ((new_turn_number - 1) * 2) % len(queue)\n            next_actor = queue[next_index]\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_number = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                (next_actor, new_turn_number, campaign_id),\n            )\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchone()\n            sequence = (row[0] if row and row[0] is not None else 0) + 1\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text, next_actor) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (campaign_id, sequence, \"resolution\", actor, text, next_actor),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return {\n                \"sequence\": sequence,\n                \"kind\": \"resolution\",\n                \"actor\": actor,\n                \"text\": text,\n                \"next_actor\": next_actor,\n                \"turn_number\": new_turn_number,\n            }\n\n    def get_narrations(self, campaign_id, limit=None):\n        \"\"\"Return narration and action events for a campaign in chronological order.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            sql = (\n                \"SELECT sequence, kind, actor, type, text, next_actor FROM narrations \"\n                \"WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY sequence DESC\"\n            )\n            params = [campaign_id]\n            if limit is not None:\n                sql += \" LIMIT ?\"\n                params.append(int(limit))\n            rows = conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall()\n            events = []\n            for r in reversed(rows):\n                event = {\"sequence\": r[0], \"kind\": r[1], \"actor\": r[2], \"text\": r[4]}\n                if r[3] is not None:\n                    event[\"type\"] = r[3]\n                if r[5] is not None:\n                    event[\"next_actor\"] = r[5]\n                events.append(event)\n            return events\n\n    # --- Scenes ---\n\n    def create_scene(self, campaign_id, scene_id, name):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            try:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO scenes (campaign_id, id, name, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, scene_id, name, \"open\"),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_scene(self, campaign_id, scene_id):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT name, status FROM scenes WHERE campaign_id = ?
